game_title: Fallback: Guess Until Right – Mine Cart Tunnel
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must hold off skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Then check guess_range and advance.
player_objective: Protect the stone seal from skeleton miners in Mine Cart Tunnel: keep guess_range above zero until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 4, Level 7, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
